en.headline: CBRE says Grade A office rents rise for a fourth quarter
en.dek: The consultancy put the third-quarter gain at 3.2 percent and the vacancy rate at 15.5 percent at the end of September.
body: Grade A office rents in Hong Kong rose 3.2 percent quarter on quarter in the third quarter, a fourth consecutive quarterly increase, CBRE said in a report cited by RTHK. The firm put the year-to-date rise at 6.7 percent.

The vacancy rate fell to 15.5 percent at the end of September, down 0.8 percentage points from the previous quarter. Net absorption in the third quarter was 858,600 square feet, taking the year-to-date total to 1.8 million square feet, the highest for the first nine months of a year since 2018, the report said.

On shops, rents in core-district street shops and major malls rose 0.9 percent and 0.7 percent quarter on quarter. Core street-shop vacancy was 6 percent at the end of September, down 0.5 percentage points and the second-lowest level in nearly seven years. Street-shop rents have now risen for 17 quarters, CBRE said.
Industrial and logistics rents fell 0.2 percent to 0.7 percent in the quarter. Warehouse vacancy eased to 11.3 percent, down 0.3 percentage points.

Commercial property investment reached 18 billion dollars in the quarter, up 79 percent from the previous quarter. Investors put 5.3 billion dollars into student-hostel conversion projects. Luxury home prices were up 5.3 percent since the start of the year and 11.3 percent above the March 2025 low, the report said. There were 197 residential deals of more than 100 million dollars in the first three quarters, about double the same period a year earlier, with the total value up nearly 55 percent to 28.2 billion dollars.

zh.headline: 世邦魏理仕：甲廈租金連升四季
zh.dek: 報告指第三季甲級寫字樓租金按季升3.2%，9月底空置率降至15.5%。
body: 世邦魏理仕報告指，香港第三季甲級寫字樓整體租金按季升3.2%，連升四個季度，年初至今累計升6.7%。香港電台引述該報告報道。
9月底空置率跌至15.5%，按季下降0.8個百分點。第三季淨吸納量為85.86萬平方呎，年初至今累計180萬平方呎，為2018年以來同期首九個月最高水平。
商舖方面，第三季核心區街舖及主要購物商場租金分別按季升0.9%及0.7%。9月底核心區街舖空置率為6%，按季回落0.5個百分點，創近七年以來第二低水平，街舖租金已連升17個季度。
工業及物流物業租金上季按季跌0.2%至0.7%，倉庫空置率回落至11.3%，按季下降0.3個百分點。
商業地產投資成交額上季達180億元，按季增79%。投資者向學生宿舍改建項目投放53億元。報告又指，年初以來豪宅樓價升5.3%，較去年3月低位高11.3%。首三季逾1億元住宅買賣有197宗，按年約升1.1倍，總成交金額升近55%至282億元。
